plan.title: Create an organisation

sales.title: Talk to our sales team

summary.label: Your plan
summary.nextFree: It's created straight away, and you're taken into it.
summary.nextPaid: You'll pay on the next page. The organisation is created once the payment goes through; leave before paying and nothing is created or charged.
summary.nextSales: Our team gets in touch to plan your rollout. You can start on Free meanwhile and move up later.

cancelled.title: Payment cancelled
cancelled.body: Nothing was created or charged. Your details are kept; continue when you're ready.
cancelled.bodyPlain: Nothing was created or charged. Choose a plan to try again.
